files.description: One-page “Discipline Records” email from Drew Edwards, October 14. Its filename does not describe a completed audit.
Two-page Perez email chain about TIPS/Sourcewell drone procurement, explicitly referencing CITY-2026-199. Appears unrelated to the eight Flock categories; reason for inclusion is not supplied.
Four-page Hicks response and forwarded request. Public copy removes requester contact details and routing tokens; response and request body are retained.
Five-page ALPR Policy 11.08.00, effective March 24, 2026. Responsive policy; not a completed audit or statistical report.

Two-page September 17 drone-contract legal-advice email. City-supplied blackouts retained. Drone procurement, not substantiation of Flock case-solving or proof of completed audits; its advice is not a judicial finding.
Two-page vendor sole-source/product description, including cloud storage language. General vendor assertions, not Sherwood outcome statistics or a site-specific storage agreement.
